items.title: A 'canary in the coal mine': Measles resurgence exposes weaknesses in U.S. public health, experts say
items.summary: The measles resurgence exposes the U.S.' public health weaknesses, such as declining vaccination rates and waning trust in health institutions, experts say.

items.title: Zhang Kun still bets on tech: half of his sole fund's top-10 holdings in global AI semiconductors
items.summary: Per the latest Q3 disclosure, Zhang Kun's sole fund, E Fund Asian Selection, has AUM of 3.69 billion yuan, with half its top-10 holdings in global AI semiconductors.

items.title: GM will switch to Nasdaq from the NYSE on Nov. 17
items.summary: GM expects to keep its “GM” ticker symbol, and the company says shareholders do not need to take action because of the transfer.
